manifest.name: 音乐搜索
manifest.author: Yggdrasil
manifest.description: 用 iTunes Search API 搜歌与专辑，拿到可直接播放的 30 秒试听直链与封面图。

fields.label: 市场（国家/地区代码）
fields.hint: 默认 TW。实测可用的有 TW / HK / US / JP / SG / GB —— 注意 CN 这个店面的音乐目录是空的（搜什么都返回 0 条）。

endpoints.name: search
endpoints.label: 搜索歌曲
endpoints.description: Search the iTunes catalogue for songs. Give term (song, artist or album name). Returns, for each hit: trackName, artistName, collectionName, previewUrl (a directly playable 30-second audio URL — put it in an <audio> element), artworkUrl100 (cover art), trackViewUrl, trackTimeMillis, artistId. If previewUrl is missing for a hit, that track has no playable preview — say so instead of inventing a URL.

params.name: term
params.description: what to search for (song title, artist, or album)

params.name: market
params.description: storefront country code; overrides the market set in the plugin panel for this call (use it when a search comes back empty)

endpoints.emptyHint: resultCount is 0: this term matched nothing in this storefront. Before giving up, retry once with a different market (pass market="US", "HK", "TW", "JP", "SG" or "GB") — the catalogue differs per country. If it is still empty, say so plainly; do not keep retrying.

endpoints.name: artist_tracks
endpoints.label: 按歌手取歌
endpoints.description: List songs by one artist, using the artistId returned by a previous search. Returns the same fields as search. Use it when the user asks for "more songs by this artist" or picks a song from a search result.

params.name: artistId
params.description: artist id from a search result

params.name: market
params.description: storefront country code; overrides the market set in the plugin panel for this call (use it when a search comes back empty)

endpoints.emptyHint: resultCount is 0: this term matched nothing in this storefront. Before giving up, retry once with a different market (pass market="US", "HK", "TW", "JP", "SG" or "GB") — the catalogue differs per country. If it is still empty, say so plainly; do not keep retrying.

guide: # music-search Search the iTunes catalogue and get **30-second audio previews** that the browser can play. ## Workflow: "play " 1. `music-search.search` with `term` = the song (plus artist if you know it). 2. Pick the hit whose `trackName` / `artistName` matches. **If nothing matches well, say so** — do not guess a URL. 3. Build a component with `create_component` that renders: - the track title and artist, - `` for the cover (you may swap `100x100` in the URL for `300x300` to get a sharper image), - `
